title: docs(spec): the app page record binding's describe and TSDoc say what the console does
body:
domain:spec#3 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgTqqeHSwZYJmApbDCa

_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuKB8Sg6c6sVpL96ruVvdxaf)_

Fixes #30614

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`page.zod.ts` 中 app 页面 `record` 绑定的 describe 与 `PageRecordBindingSchema` TSDoc,以及组件 `visibleWhen` 的 describe 与 TSDoc,改写为控制台的真实行为,并重新生成参考页。
- 为什么改:旧文案说"渲染器尚未实现、`record` 不绑定",而控制台早已读取它;照文案写元数据的作者和 AI 会放弃一个能用的绑定。
- 风险与回滚:仅文案,无键、形状、默认值或导出变化;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts`(四处文案:`PageRecordBindingSchema` TSDoc、`record` describe、组件 `visibleWhen` TSDoc 含其「Measured on the renderer」段、`visibleWhen` describe)、`content/docs/ui/pages.mdx`(手写指南 `record` 行)、`packages/spec/liveness/page.json`(两条说明)。
- 两分钟验证:`git grep -n "Planned in the renderer\|faulting predicate renders\|configEvaluationScope" -- packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts content/docs ':!content/docs/releases'` 预期零命中(在 4afb99547 实测退出码 1、无输出)。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts`, the `PageRecordBindingSchema` TSDoc: the "Planned in the renderer" paragraph is replaced by what the console does. The binding is read once per page open (the first row under `sort`, under the caller's identity); every component's `visibleWhen` sees that row as `record`; a record block that binds its own row still provides that row to its own subtree; and the three states a predicate sees (pending: the body is not drawn; no row, or a read the server refuses as forbidden (403): `record` is null; any other failure: the body is not drawn). A page drawn through `interfaceConfig.source` reads no binding (round 2).
- The same file, the `record` key's `.describe()`: the same reading, in one string. The parse half is unchanged and still stated: `type: 'app'` only (`checkPageRecordBindingPlacement`), a strict one-row shape with no `limit`.
- The same file, the component `visibleWhen` TSDoc and `.describe()` (round 2, review escalation): "a faulting `visibleWhen` renders the component ... a gate that never gates" (TSDoc), "a faulting predicate renders the component, so such a gate never gates" and, for `hasCapability` on a host with no capability list, "a faulting predicate renders the component" (describe) now say the console withholds the component. `data.total > 0` and `data.total == 0` both hide it. The advice that the page's row is `record` is kept.
- The same file, the `visibleWhen` TSDoc's "Measured on the renderer" paragraph (round 3, delta review 6672431263). It named `configEvaluationScope`, which does not exist under `ui/`, and said `record` is added "only when the page has a row — on an app page, once the renderer mounts the page's `record` binding". It now names `buildNodeEvaluationScope` and says `record` is the page's row: the record a record page opens, or the row an app page's `record` binding reads, `null` when that read finds no row or is refused as forbidden.
- `content/docs/references/ui/page.mdx`: regenerated by `gen:docs`, never hand-edited.
- `content/docs/ui/pages.mdx` :63, the hand-written `record` row of the Pages guide: "Planned in the renderer: until the console mounts it, `record` stays unbound on an `app` page" is replaced by the describe's reading, in the same words, kept as one table cell (round 1). A grep of `content/docs` outside `releases/` for "stays unbound" and "Planned in the renderer" now finds no hit.
- `packages/spec/liveness/page.json`, the `props.regions` note (round 3): the `[120] PageComponent.visibleWhen` read point named `SchemaRenderer.tsx#configEvaluationScope` with `record` "only when the page has a row". It now names `ui/packages/react/src/SchemaRenderer.tsx#buildNodeEvaluationScope` (noting the old name at objectui @1fb1ced36243) and states the same `record` reading as the TSDoc.
- `packages/spec/liveness/page.json`, the `props.record` note: its last sentence said this describe and TSDoc were stale. This PR makes that false, so it now says they state the same reading.
- `.changeset/30614-page-record-binding-describe.md`: `@objectstack/spec` patch, which also names the Pages guide row.

Every sentence was checked against the readers on `origin/main` `b8929f486`: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/PageView.tsx` (`appPageRecordBinding`, `AppPageRecordGate`, `AppPageRecordRead` with `$top: 1` and `$orderby` from `sort`), `ui/packages/app-shell/src/providers/ExpressionProvider.tsx#PageRecordScope`, `ui/packages/react/src/SchemaRenderer.tsx#buildNodeEvaluationScope`, and the pin `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/PageView.appPageRecord-12931.test.tsx`.

## Tests

No behaviour changes, so there is no new test and no ablation. The `@objectstack/spec` page suites pass, spec typecheck passes, and `check:generated` reports all 14 artifacts up to date.

## Acceptance notes

- Two old sentences beyond "Planned in the renderer" were also false against the console, and were replaced as part of stating the three states. The TSDoc said zero rows or a refused row "leaves `record` unbound: a predicate reading it faults, and a faulting `visibleWhen` renders the component". The describe said "No row, no `record`: the predicate faults and the component renders". On `main`, `AppPageRecordRead` binds `record` as `null` for both cases (pinned by the 0-row and 403 cases of the pin test). Separately, `SchemaRenderer.tsx#visibilityFaultOutcome` now fails a declared `visibleWhen` closed on a fault, so "renders" is no longer the verdict. The new text does not describe the fault verdict of a field read on a null `record`, because no test pins it.
- `packages/spec/liveness/page.json`, the `props.record` note: its last sentence ("The schema's own describe() and TSDoc still say 'Planned in the renderer' — stale prose left for a spec change") was made false by this PR. It now reads "The schema's own describe() and TSDoc state this same reading." It ships (`liveness` is in the package's `files`), the claim's file surface was amended to hold it (6670237155), and `check:liveness` is green.
- `content/docs/ui/pages.mdx` :63 carried the same stale sentence and is fixed in round 1, under the amended claim (6670237155). The Pages guide row was already silent on the no-row verdict, so only the "Planned in the renderer" sentence was false there. It gains the three states the describe states, and no claim the describe does not make.
- Round 2 (contract review 6671102362, PASS, should-fix S1-S3 and the escalation; claim amendment 6671162776):
  - S1: "a refused read" is narrowed to "a read the server refuses as forbidden (403)". Only 403 / `PERMISSION_DENIED` / `FORBIDDEN` classify `forbidden` (`ui/packages/react/src/utils/error-message.ts`). A 401, a 400 or rejected read, and api-disabled land in the failed-read state.
  - S2: the TSDoc drops "and the failed-read state stands in its place". An unresolved view, a refused filter or no adapter draws the gate's own panel (`ElementDataSourceGate.tsx`). The TSDoc now agrees with the describe: any other failure draws no page body.
  - S3: an `app` page that also sets `interfaceConfig.source` is drawn as `InterfaceListPage` outside `AppPageRecord` (`PageView.tsx`), so it reads no binding. One clause in both texts, and no refinement.
  - Escalation: since objectui#13299, `visibilityFaultOutcome` (`SchemaRenderer.tsx`) answers a declared `visibleWhen` that faults with `false`, pinned by `SchemaRenderer.nodeVisibilityFailClosed-13299.test.tsx` and `SchemaRenderer.visibleWhenRecordBinding.test.tsx` ("WITHHOLDS the block").
  - Grep of `packages/spec/src/**` (non-test) and the hand-written `content/docs/**` for "faulting predicate renders", "faulting `visibleWhen` renders" and "never gates": only the `page.zod.ts` sites carried the false claim. The other hits (`automation/schemaless-node-config.zod.ts` decision `condition`, `ui/action.zod.ts` `pressed`, `data/object.zod.ts` `disabledWhen` fail-soft, `kernel/public-auth-features.ts`, two migration entries) carry no visibility fault-renders claim and are untouched.
  - Round 2b: `content/docs/ui/pages.mdx` :63 now matches the round-2 describe word for word on the two points, with "no row, or a read the server refuses as forbidden (403), binds `record` as null" and "A page drawn through `interfaceConfig.source` reads no binding". It is still one table cell and adds no other claim.
  - Not changed: the `ui/packages/app-shell/src/providers/ExpressionProvider.tsx` `PageRecordScope` docblock still states the fail-soft verdict (no `ui/` change).
- `packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts` keeps "re-read when the bound object is written": `AppPageRecordRead` keys its read on `useDataInvalidation(object)`, so it is still true beside "once per page open".
